notes.content:
Report issues and help support the game by Joining the CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN [url=https://discord.com/invite/49a74wAFRu]DISCORD[/url].

- (FIX) Issue where your hand can't be selected correctly VS Helio (after taking their last turn).

[h2]LEAVING EARLY ACCESS[/h2]

In the interest of trying to build a bigger player base - and in preparation for our console release - we are moving CITY WARS out of Early Access. During EA, player feedback has been crucial in helping us create a more stable, playable game. There have been a [b]LOT [/b] of fixes and changes in response to player feedback and we'd like to thank everyone who's posted comments and questions via Steam and Discord.

Obviously, this isn't the end of supporting the game. We'll continue to update with any fixes that are required as we build towards MP.

notes.title: New Update & District War Mode
notes.content:
Report issues and help support the game by Joining the CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN [url=https://discord.com/invite/49a74wAFRu]DISCORD[/url].

NEW BUILD
V0.3.1
REV 34474

- (FIX) Correct card now shows in deck profile overview.
- (FIX) Windowed Mode now switches correctly.
- (FIX) Fixed Acid Effect bug that would freeze the track.
- (FIX) Enemies can no longer bank a frozen card (stopping them from playing the frozen card onto the Battle Track).
- (FIX) SHIELDED BREAKOUT wouldn't buff if connected to the left of any shield.
- (FIX) Optimisations made to culling system within Deck Builder to improve FPS.
- (FIX) MED-BOT no longer stays on-screen when triggered without an attack to follow.
- (FIX) ATTACK/EFFECT+ Support Cards now pause correctly when triggered on the top track.
- (ADDITION) Updated to newer version of Unity (2021.3.4f1).

[h2]DISTRICT WAR PROGRESS[/h2]

Part of updating to the latest version of Unity is to prepare for DISTRICT WAR, which brings online multiplayer to the world of CITY WARS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40946758/100f653c8de3cdb970850d05732c0eacd6a5b882.png[/img]

The Precinct acts as your multiplayer HUB: a place where you can edit your deck, check the leaderboards and purchase new Utility Cards for the battles ahead. On this screen, you'll also be able to track your progress via the HUD in the top-left of the screen. Here you can see your total XP (brining you closer to new rewards) and your current Bounty.

Bounty is used as DISTRICT WAR'S scoring system. You'll earn bonus points for winning battles and achieving certain win criteria. Raise your bounty as you attempt to the top the crime database and become the city's Most Wanted.

At certain XP milestones (indicated by the progress bar) you'll level-up. This increases your badge and awards you with new cards and guns, giving you greater customisation over your deck options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40946758/a20304b352a0167829a5c3ef161c02328ecf0eed.png[/img]

In the coming weeks, we'll be setting up a new branch, allowing players to test DISTRICT WAR with the team before it goes live.

notes.title: SURVIVAL MODE & NEW CARDS
notes.content:
Hi,

Today's update introduces some new content to the world of [b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b].

[h2]SURVIVAL MODE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40946758/3012735b36eea7c768714d1eb1e29fe53e1bcadc.png[/img]

[b]SURVIVAL MODE[/b] gives you the freedom to edit and design your own [b]COMBAT CASE[/b] with no restrictions. In this mode, all cards, guns and charms are unlocked for you to play with, and your objective is simple: starting with 500 Health, make your way through the [b]COMBAT SIMULATOR[/b] in a bid to survive as long as possible.

Not only will this give expert players a new mode to try and conquer, but it also allows newcomers to experiment with the game's systems in a more casual environment.

[h2]NEW CARDS[/h2]

[b]5[/b] new [b]ADVANCED CARDS[/b] have been added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40946758/4e3ee7c73e811ff5cb865ec97fc2ad4058a43b61.png[/img]

These cards are designed to provide extra synergies and deck building options. When played, each card will buff the [b]ACCURACY [/b]and [b]DAMAGE [/b]values of any matching [b]DURATIONS [/b]in your current hand. Feel free to experiment with these new cards immediately in [b]SURVIVAL MODE[/b] to see how they work.

[h2]LEADERBOARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]

We're pleased to announce that [b]STEAM LEADERBOARD[/b] support has been added for both [b]DISTRICT RUN[/b] and [b]SURVIVAL MODE[/b]. Your top scores will now be posted globally and can be compared with other players. We've added a data migration feature that should automatically upload your previous scores to the [b]DISTRICT RUN[/b] leaderboard, but feel free to stay engaged and try to post better ones ːsteamthumbsupː

Finally, keep a eye out for some new STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS included in today's build. These mostly relate to SURVIVAL MODE, but we've added a very challenging extra just for our expert players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40946758/092e871aaacb1722ce66d7c6df4d27ff942e5c42.png[/img]

If you haven't already, remember to join the [b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b] DISCORD by clicking [url=https://discord.gg/49a74wAFRu]HERE[/url]. Your feedback and support is appreciated.

We're looking forward to chatting (and checking out those final totals)...

Good luck!

notes.title: CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Hi,

We're pleased to announce our release date for [b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b]. The game will be launching into Early Access on [b]26th April 2022[/b]. So... not long to wait.

A select group have been playing the game over the last couple of weeks, and as more people get hands-on, hopefully you'll start seeing more playthroughs/streams of the game. We appreciate all of your feedback and coverage: it genuinely helps us improve the game.

Early Access is a great opportunity for [b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b]. If you've been following along, you'll know that our game is a unique concept that has a [b]LOT [/b] of new ideas. Early Access allows us to gather feedback and work with our community to grow/improve the experience over time. We're confident in our game and we've tried our hardest to make sure our Early Access launch provides a strong platform to grow from.

It will be fun to see players take on the game's District Run mode at launch, and we can't wait to see everyone's progression. We encourage players to share their progress and help spread the word. We'll be providing social channels (including the game's Discord) in the days prior to launch.

Look forward to seeing you on the streets,
The Mojo Bones Team

notes.title: CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN SINGLEPLAYER WALKTHROUGH
notes.content:
Hi, it's time to dig into [b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN'S[/b] single-player mode...

Welcome to DISTRICT RUN.

In the previous walkthrough we detailed the game's core battle mechanics ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZJcjeipL-hY]check it out[/url] if you haven’t already). Now it's time to explore everything surrounding combat, and how these features combine to create a dynamic, engaging - and replayable - solo experience.

[previewyoutube=sK-iNR8E2N0;full][/previewyoutube]

We've spent many hours battling across Neo-Tokyo, and very rarely do we encounter the same playthrough...

Some runs are difficult, requiring you to survive across multiple checkpoints with minimum health, desperately trying to reach the next HQ for some much-needed upgrades. Other runs feel exhilarating, as you level-up powerful cards, discover rare guns and bend the city's District Stats in your favour.

As always, we welcome/appreciate your feedback and please help support the game by sharing our media with friends and like-minded gamers.

We look forward to seeing how you fare on the streets of Neo-Tokyo.

notes.title: CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN GAMEPLAY WALKTHROUGH
notes.content:
Hi, we'd like to unveil our [b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b] gameplay walkthrough.

This is our attempt to lift the lid on how the game plays and why we consider it to be so unique. We hope you enjoy the vid, and please feel free to share with like-minded gamers [i](and, of course, leave any comments/questions)[/i]...

[previewyoutube=ZJcjeipL-hY;full][/previewyoutube]

Developing a unique concept comes with its own challenges. 

Firstly, you don't have anything else to lean on. Game development can often be about playing and researching other experiences to see how certain problems have been solved (R&D is a [u]good [/u]thing). With CITY WARS however, there's been no other point-of-reference. We've had to invent this thing from the ground-up (which has been fun, but slightly scary).

Secondly - as with any new concept - you're putting something fresh into the gaming space and don't really have a benchmark for its success. It's also very difficult to describe exactly what it is that you're making, You don't have the luxury of leaning on the obligatory [b][i]"It's like [insert game x] mixed with a little of [insert game y]"[/i][/b].

So, anyway, with all that said, this is [b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b]. We hope you dig it.

notes.title: CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN BETA TEST
notes.content:
[b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b] is taking-shape, and we're looking for beta testers to get hands-on with the latest build. A limited number of Steam keys will be sent out soon. Visit the game's community page by clicking [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1689090/discussions/0/3182360420557600079/]here [/url]to register your interest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40946758/0a824049e459843b6ee02a8d77d840fbc6e034e0.png[/img]

[b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b] is an original concept built from the ground-up. It's an eclectic mix of card-battler, block puzzler and Roguelike, designed to appeal to a wide audience, so we're looking for players of all types and skill levels.

[b]CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN[/b] features...

[list]
[*] Unique gameplay that puts a new spin on card battling. Physically fit your attacks onto the Battle Track to build up Damage, then witness the battle play-out in the Combat Phase, where attacks are triggered.
[*] A robust single-player mode called [b]DISTRICT RUN[/b] that challenges you to build a collection of cards and push your way across a randomly generated city. Battle enemies, trigger events, tussle with dilemmas and defeat bosses as you try to reach the end of the Shadow District.
[*] [b]DISTRICT WAR[/b] is the game's standalone multiplayer mode. Build and customise a persistent deck and use it battle other players. Level-up and improve your [b]Bounty [/b]by defeating opponents. Can you become the city's Most Wanted? 
[/list]

[b]STAY TUNED FOR AN UPCOMING WALKTHROUGH VIDEO & THANKS FOR YOUR SUPPORT![/b]
